title: Precipitation downscaling under climate change: Recent developments to bridge the gap between dynamical models and the end user
relevance_note: The foundational precipitation-downscaling review; where the PP / MOS / weather-generator taxonomy is laid out.

title: On the Use of Reanalysis Data for Downscaling
relevance_note: 'On the Use of Reanalysis Data for Downscaling' — the canonical entry point on reanalysis-as-predictor-source. NOTE: abstract not retrievable, cited at title level.

title: Skill, Correction, and Downscaling of GCM-Simulated Precipitation
relevance_note: Skill, correction and downscaling of GCM-simulated precipitation; a standard reference on when correction is and is not legitimate. NOTE: abstract not retrievable, cited at title level.

title: Reassessing Statistical Downscaling Techniques for Their Robust Application under Climate Change Conditions
relevance_note: Reassessing statistical downscaling for robust application under changing conditions; the extrapolation-robustness question in its pre-DL form.

title: Bias Correction, Quantile Mapping, and Downscaling: Revisiting the Inflation Issue
relevance_note: The inflation paper: why regression-based downscaling and quantile mapping cannot simultaneously get the conditional mean and the variance right, and why inflating variance corrupts the deterministic signal. The core theoretical statement behind 'MSE-trained models under-represent small-scale variance'.

title: Stochastic Model Output Statistics for Bias Correcting and Downscaling Precipitation Including Extremes
relevance_note: Stochastic model output statistics for bias correction and downscaling including extremes; the stochastic-MOS template.

title: DeepSD
relevance_note: Origin point for CNN super-resolution downscaling (DeepSD, stacked SRCNN). Historical anchor only; superseded methodologically.

title: An intercomparison of a large ensemble of statistical downscaling methods over Europe: Results from the VALUE perfect predictor cross‐validation experiment
relevance_note: VALUE perfect-predictor cross-validation experiment: >50 downscaling methods, 86 European stations, all three families (PP, MOS, weather generators). The largest controlled intercomparison; note that its predictors are deliberately 'perfect' reanalysis.

title: Statistical downscaling skill under present climate conditions: A synthesis of the VALUE perfect predictor experiment
relevance_note: CRITICAL for framing. Synthesis of the VALUE perfect-predictor experiment. States that MOS needs predictors near the target resolution, that PP skill depends crucially on model structure and predictor choice, that inter-annual variability is under-represented by both PP methods and weather generators, and that spatial variability is poorly represented by almost all methods.

title: Cross-validation of bias-corrected climate simulations is misleading
relevance_note: Cross-validation of bias-corrected free-running simulations is misleading: the residual bias in the validation period depends on the difference in change between calibration and validation periods, which is dominated by internal variability. Directly relevant to interpreting held-out-period scores.

title: Neural Networks for Postprocessing Ensemble Weather Forecasts
relevance_note: MOST DIRECTLY USABLE. Neural-network distributional regression postprocessing of 2-m temperature at surface STATIONS in Germany, using station embeddings and auxiliary predictors; beats benchmark postprocessing and is explicitly cheaper computationally. This is the method class that fits the user's data and hardware.

title: Configuration and intercomparison of deep learning neural models for statistical downscaling
relevance_note: Benchmark CNN-vs-GLM intercomparison for downscaling over Europe inside the VALUE framework, using 'perfect' reanalysis predictors. The reference configuration study; read for how a defensible DL downscaling validation is set up.

title: Deep-Learning-Based Gridded Downscaling of Surface Meteorological Variables in Complex Terrain. Part I: Daily Maximum and Minimum 2-m Temperature
venue: Journal of Applied Meteorology and Climatology
relevance_note: U-Net gridded downscaling of daily max/min 2-m temperature in complex terrain. One of the few grid-to-grid DL papers targeting temperature rather than precipitation.

title: Deep-Learning-Based Gridded Downscaling of Surface Meteorological Variables in Complex Terrain. Part II: Daily Precipitation
venue: Journal of Applied Meteorology and Climatology
relevance_note: Companion Part II for daily precipitation.

title: A comparative study of convolutional neural network models for wind field downscaling
relevance_note: CNN/U-Net (DeepRU) downscaling of short-range 100-m WIND forecasts from ERA5 31 km to HRES 9 km, with static high-res predictors (topography, land-sea mask, roughness). Closest architectural template for a wind-focused, forecast-applied, modest-resolution-jump task.

title: Statistical Postprocessing for Weather Forecasts: Review, Challenges, and Avenues in a Big Data World
venue: Bulletin of the American Meteorological Society
relevance_note: Community review of statistical postprocessing for weather forecasts. This is the MOS-framing review the user actually needs, as distinct from the climate downscaling literature.

title: Stochastic Super-Resolution for Downscaling Time-Evolving Atmospheric Fields With a Generative Adversarial Network
venue: IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing
relevance_note: Recurrent stochastic super-resolution GAN generating ensembles of time-evolving high-resolution fields (Swiss radar precipitation, GOES-16 cloud optical thickness), evaluated with rank statistics. The origin of stochastic SR in this field.

title: Adversarial super-resolution of climatological wind and solar data
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
relevance_note: Adversarial super-resolution of climatological wind and solar fields; the highly cited GAN-SR reference outside precipitation.

title: On the suitability of deep convolutional neural networks for continental-wide downscaling of climate change projections
relevance_note: Companion to the above: takes the same CNNs from reanalysis predictors to GCM predictors and tests the two key assumptions explicitly. This is the perfect-prognosis assumption being stress-tested.

title: Deep Learning for Daily Precipitation and Temperature Downscaling
relevance_note: Widely cited DL downscaling of daily precipitation and temperature; general background.

title: Skilful precipitation nowcasting using deep generative models of radar
relevance_note: Deep generative radar nowcasting; states explicitly that unconstrained deterministic deep learning produces blurry forecasts at longer lead times with poor performance on heavier rain. The clearest published statement of the MSE-blurring failure mode.

title: Machine learning methods for postprocessing ensemble forecasts of wind gusts: A systematic comparison
relevance_note: Systematic comparison of eight statistical and ML postprocessing methods for wind gusts (EMOS, member-by-member, isotonic distributional regression, gradient-boosted EMOS, quantile regression forests, distributional regression network, Bernstein quantile network, histogram estimation network). The benchmark ladder to reproduce before attempting anything generative.

title: Regional climate model emulator based on deep learning: concept and first evaluation of a novel hybrid downscaling approach
relevance_note: RCM emulator via neural network: learns the RCM's own downscaling function for near-surface temperature. The emulator framing that makes the perfect/imperfect distinction concrete.

title: A Generative Deep Learning Approach to Stochastic Downscaling of Precipitation Forecasts
venue: Journal of Advances in Modeling Earth Systems
relevance_note: Extends the stochastic GAN from reconstruction of coarsened fields to the harder problem of increasing accuracy AND resolution of actual low-resolution forecast-model input, with high-resolution radar as truth. This is the MOS-framing generative downscaling paper.

title: Physically constrained generative adversarial networks for improving precipitation fields from Earth system models
relevance_note: Physically constrained GAN for improving ESM precipitation fields; the constraint-injection approach to keeping generative output physical.

title: Downscaling of Historical Wind Fields over Switzerland Using Generative Adversarial Networks
venue: Artificial Intelligence for the Earth Systems
relevance_note: GAN downscaling of historical WIND fields over Switzerland. Wind-specific generative downscaling in complex terrain.

title: Deep learning downscaled high-resolution daily near surface meteorological datasets over East Asia
relevance_note: U-Net downscaling producing a nine-variable 0.1 deg dataset over East Asia from CMIP6 + MSWX. Example of the bias-correct-then-U-Net production pipeline.

authors: Marijn van der Meer et al.
title: Deep Learning Regional Climate Model Emulators: A Comparison of Two Downscaling Training Frameworks
venue: Journal of Advances in Modeling Earth Systems
relevance_note: CRITICAL for framing. Directly compares a 'perfect model' training framework (upscaled RCM predictors) against an 'imperfect' one (actual GCM predictors). The perfect-framework emulator scored well on upscaled data but propagated GCM-RCM inconsistencies and underestimated when driven by real GCM output. This is the formal demonstration that skill measured in the perfect setting does not transfer.

title: Using Explainability to Inform Statistical Downscaling Based on Deep Learning Beyond Standard Validation Approaches
venue: Journal of Advances in Modeling Earth Systems
relevance_note: Explainability-based evaluation of perfect-prognosis DL downscaling models, arguing standard validation is insufficient and introducing saliency diagnostics. Read for why held-out RMSE is not enough.

title: Using Machine Learning to Cut the Cost of Dynamical Downscaling
relevance_note: ML as a cheaper substitute for dynamical downscaling; framing of cost-vs-skill tradeoff.

title: Postprocessing of Ensemble Weather Forecasts Using Permutation-Invariant Neural Networks
venue: Artificial Intelligence for the Earth Systems
relevance_note: Permutation-invariant networks that consume the raw ensemble as an unordered set rather than summary statistics, for temperature and wind gusts. The right architecture for 51 exchangeable AIFS-ENS members.

title: Accurate medium-range global weather forecasting with 3D neural networks
relevance_note: Pangu-Weather; background on the deterministic AI-forecasting baseline that downscaling work is layered onto.

authors: Pedro M. M. Soares et al.
title: High-resolution downscaling of CMIP6 Earth system and global climate models using deep learning for Iberia
relevance_note: Four CNN architectures downscaling seven CMIP6 models to 0.1 deg over Iberia. Useful for architecture-choice evidence at a regional scale.

title: Enhancing Regional Climate Downscaling through Advances in Machine Learning
venue: Artificial Intelligence for the Earth Systems
relevance_note: Review of ML advances for regional climate downscaling. Best single orientation review for the DL downscaling field.

title: The Rise of Data-Driven Weather Forecasting: A First Statistical Assessment of Machine Learning–Based Weather Forecasts in an Operational-Like Context
venue: Bulletin of the American Meteorological Society
relevance_note: First systematic statistical assessment of data-driven forecasts in an operational-like context at ECMWF. Establishes what baseline AI-model skill looks like before any downscaling.

title: Do AI models produce better weather forecasts than physics-based models? A quantitative evaluation case study of Storm Ciarán
relevance_note: Case-study evaluation of four ML models on a European windstorm: synoptic structure well captured. Relevant to whether AI forecasts are a sound base for regional downscaling.

title: Probabilistic weather forecasting with machine learning
relevance_note: GenCast: diffusion-based probabilistic medium-range forecasting. The reference for generative ensembles at global scale.

title: Generative emulation of weather forecast ensembles with diffusion models
relevance_note: Generative diffusion emulation of forecast ensembles (SEEDS); cheap ensemble augmentation from few members.

title: On the Extrapolation of Generative Adversarial Networks for Downscaling Precipitation Extremes in Warmer Climates
relevance_note: Quantifies the generative-vs-deterministic gap for extremes under extrapolation: for 99.5th-percentile precipitation, a GAN trained on future climate recovered 97% of the warming-driven increase versus 65% for the deterministic CNN baseline, and a historically trained GAN still recovered 77%. The strongest single number for 'generative beats MSE on the tails'.

title: Quantile-Regression-Ensemble: A Deep Learning Algorithm for Downscaling Extreme Precipitation
venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
relevance_note: Quantile-regression ensemble for downscaling extreme precipitation; a cheaper alternative to adversarial training for tail calibration.

title: A Practical Probabilistic Benchmark for AI Weather Models
relevance_note: Lagged-ensemble probabilistic benchmark for AI weather models; shows deterministic scores rank models differently from probabilistic skill. Cautionary for how to score a downscaling system.

title: Huge ensembles – Part 1: Design of ensemble weather forecasts using spherical Fourier neural operators
relevance_note: Huge ensembles with spherical Fourier neural operators; design considerations for very large ML ensembles.

title: Power Spectra of Physics‐Based and Data‐Driven Ensembles
relevance_note: Power spectra of physics-based and data-driven ECMWF ensembles, including where spread and error diverge by scale. The diagnostic framework for the variance-deficit question.

title: A Reliable Generative Adversarial Network Approach for Climate Downscaling and Weather Generation
venue: Journal of Advances in Modeling Earth Systems
relevance_note: A GAN design aimed at reliability (calibrated ensembles) rather than only sharpness, for downscaling and weather generation.

title: RainScaleGAN: A Conditional Generative Adversarial Network for Rainfall Downscaling
venue: Artificial Intelligence for the Earth Systems
relevance_note: RainScaleGAN, conditional GAN for rainfall downscaling.

title: Residual corrective diffusion modeling for km-scale atmospheric downscaling
relevance_note: CorrDiff journal version: two-step design where a U-Net predicts the conditional mean and a corrector diffusion model predicts the residual, mapping 25 km global reanalysis to 2 km regional-model output over Taiwan; recovers power-law spectra that deterministic regression loses. The reference architecture for corrective diffusion.

title: Can AI be enabled to perform dynamical downscaling? A latent diffusion model to mimic kilometer-scale COSMO5.0_CLM9 simulations
relevance_note: Latent diffusion model downscaling ERA5 to 2 km over Italy for 2-m temperature and 10-m wind components, targeting COSMO-CLM output, built as a residual on a U-Net reference. The most transferable diffusion setup for the user's variables (temperature and wind, not precipitation).

title: Dynamical-generative downscaling of climate model ensembles
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
relevance_note: Dynamical-generative downscaling of climate model ensembles; the hybrid framing where a dynamical step is followed by a generative step.

title: Global spatio-temporal ERA5 precipitation downscaling to km and sub-hourly scale using generative AI
relevance_note: spateGAN-ERA5: ERA5 precipitation from 24 km/1 h to 2 km/10 min globally, trained solely on German data and validated elsewhere. Evidence on how far a regionally trained generative model transfers.

title: An artificial intelligence-based limited area model for forecasting of surface meteorological variables
relevance_note: AI-based limited-area model forecasting surface meteorological variables; the regional AI-LAM alternative to post-hoc downscaling.

title: Downscaling the probability of heavy rainfall over the Nordic countries
relevance_note: The only northern-European statistical downscaling paper retrieved: empirical-statistical downscaling of heavy-rainfall probability and IDF curves over the Nordic countries. Nearest-region precedent, but not deep learning and precipitation-focused.

title: A review of statistical methods for climate downscaling: the underexplored potential of geostatistical simulation
relevance_note: Recent review of statistical downscaling with emphasis on stochastic/geostatistical simulation. Useful counterweight to the DL-only literature.

title: AIFS-CRPS: ensemble forecasting using a model trained with a loss function based on the continuous ranked probability score
relevance_note: AIFS-CRPS journal version: an AIFS ensemble variant trained with the almost-fair CRPS, stochastic, outperforming the IFS ensemble for most variables and lead times. Read this to understand what the user's AIFS ENS input actually is.

title: A spectral test of the butterfly effect and physical consistency in the diffusion-based GenCast’s ensembles
relevance_note: Spectral test of error growth and physical consistency in GenCast ensembles. Method for checking whether a generative ensemble's fine-scale variability is physically meaningful rather than cosmetic.

title: Conditional diffusion models for downscaling and bias correction of Earth system model precipitation
relevance_note: Conditional diffusion performing bias correction and downscaling jointly, trained on observations only via a shared embedding space. Relevant because the user has only station observations as truth.

title: Efficient Kilometer‐Scale Precipitation Downscaling With Conditional Wavelet Diffusion
venue: Journal of Geophysical Research Machine Learning and Computation
relevance_note: Wavelet-domain conditional diffusion achieving 10x precipitation super-resolution to 1 km with a reported 9x inference speedup over pixel-space diffusion. Read for the efficiency trick if diffusion is attempted on limited hardware.

title: Increasing the accuracy and resolution of precipitation forecasts using deep generative models
relevance_note: CorrectorGAN: simultaneous bias correction and super-resolution of global ensemble forecasts over CONUS with radar as ground truth. Preprint; the correct-then-downscale two-stage idea in early form.

title: Generative Modeling of High-resolution Global Precipitation Forecasts
relevance_note: Generative modelling of high-resolution global precipitation forecasts. Preprint; companion to CorrectorGAN.

title: Precipitation Downscaling with Spatiotemporal Video Diffusion
relevance_note: Spatiotemporal video diffusion for precipitation super-resolution with a deterministic downscaler followed by a temporally conditioned diffusion stage, compared against six baselines on FV3GFS. Preprint; argues explicitly that the conditional distribution, not the mean, is what matters.

title: Residual Corrective Diffusion Modeling for Km-scale Atmospheric Downscaling
relevance_note: CorrDiff preprint version (journal version doi:10.1038/s43247-025-02042-5). Cite the journal version; preprint listed for completeness.

title: AIFS-CRPS: Ensemble forecasting using a model trained with a loss function based on the Continuous Ranked Probability Score
relevance_note: Preprint version of AIFS-CRPS.

title: Emerging AI-based weather prediction models as downscaling tools
relevance_note: Uses existing AI-NWP models themselves as downscaling operators, initialised from smoothed ERA5 and coarse CMIP6 fields at one-day lead, for 2-m temperature. An unusual and cheap alternative framing. Preprint.

title: TAUDiff: Highly efficient kilometer-scale downscaling using generative diffusion models
relevance_note: TAUDiff: names spectral bias in deterministic regression downscaling as the problem and pairs a deterministic mean-field model with a SMALLER generative diffusion model for the fine-scale residual, for wind velocity. Preprint; the efficiency-minded version of corrective diffusion.

title: Efficient Localized Adaptation of Neural Weather Forecasting: A Case Study in the MENA Region
relevance_note: Localised adaptation of a neural weather model for a specific region (MENA). Preprint; the fine-tuning-a-global-model-for-one-region pattern, which is the compute-feasible route.

title: Fixing the Double Penalty in Data-Driven Weather Forecasting Through a Modified Spherical Harmonic Loss Function
relevance_note: Shows that the MSE loss used by most data-driven forecast models causes double-penalty smoothing, and that a parameter-free spherical-harmonic loss modification, applied by FINE-TUNING GraphCast, raised effective resolution from 1250 km to 160 km with better ensemble spread and better surface wind extremes. The cleanest quantification of MSE-induced smoothing, and a fine-tuning-scale intervention.

title: Assessing the Geographic Generalization and Physical Consistency of Generative Models for Climate Downscaling
relevance_note: CRITICAL NEGATIVE RESULT. Benchmarks generative downscaling models with physics-inspired diagnostics and finds that CorrDiff-class models trained on central Europe fail to generalise to Iberia, Morocco or SCANDINAVIA, and fail to reproduce derived second-order fields such as divergence and vorticity. Preprint; the strongest published warning against importing a pretrained generative downscaler into northwest Russia.

title: On Global Applicability and Location Transferability of Generative Deep Learning Models for Precipitation Downscaling
relevance_note: Systematic assessment of generative precipitation-downscaling generalisation across 15 world regions using a hierarchical location-based split, with ERA5 predictors and IMERG 0.1 deg targets. Preprint; the companion transferability study.

title: CRPS-LAM: Probabilistic Regional Weather Forecasting with Continuous Ranked Probability Score
relevance_note: CRPS-LAM: hybrid CNN/GNN regional ensemble model trained on a CRPS objective, generating members in a single forward pass with roughly 39x speedup over diffusion baselines. Preprint; the compute-efficient alternative to diffusion for probabilistic regional output.

title: An update to ECMWF's machine-learned weather forecast model AIFS
relevance_note: AIFS update introducing physical-consistency bounding layers that substantially improve precipitation, operational at ECMWF since 25 February 2025. Preprint; needed to know which AIFS version an archive corresponds to.

title: On Global Applicability and Location Transferability of Generative Deep Learning Models for Precipitation Downscaling
relevance_note: Systematic assessment of generative precipitation-downscaling generalisation across 15 world regions with a hierarchical location-based split (ERA5 predictors, IMERG 0.1 deg targets). Preprint; the transferability companion to arXiv:2510.13722.

title: SwAIther-Precip: Lead-Time-Aware Bias Correction Enables Kilometer-Scale Downscaling of Global AI Precipitation Forecasts over Switzerland
relevance_note: MOST RELEVANT PAPER IN THIS TRACK. SwAIther-Precip downscales AIFS precipitation forecasts to km scale over Switzerland with an explicitly lead-time-aware design: a U-Net conditioned on lead time via feature-wise linear modulation first corrects systematic bias at coarse resolution, which then permits a cheaper super-resolution stage conditioned only on corrected precipitation and trained DIRECTLY ON OBSERVATIONS rather than on the full atmospheric state. Preprint 2026.

title: From AI Weather Prediction to Infrastructure Resilience: A Real-Time Correction-Downscaling Framework for Tropical Cyclone Impact Forecasting
relevance_note: Real-time correction-plus-downscaling of AI forecasts to 500 m wind fields for typhoon impact, reporting a 38.8% reduction in station-scale wind-speed MAE relative to Pangu-Weather and roughly 25 s per 12-h cycle on a SINGLE GPU. The clearest evidence that a correct-then-downscale pipeline is feasible on modest hardware. Preprint 2026.

title: Enhancing AI and Dynamical Subseasonal Forecasts with Probabilistic Bias Correction
relevance_note: Probabilistic bias correction applied to ECMWF's leading dynamical and AI models, reported to double AIFS subseasonal skill. Preprint 2026; relevant as the pure-postprocessing upper bound.

title: AI-Based Regional Emulation for Kilometer-Scale Dynamical Downscaling
relevance_note: AI limited-area emulator trained on ERA5 0.25 deg 3-hourly forcings against 4 km hourly CONUS404, generalising to a 1.0 deg non-ERA5 forcing. Preprint; shows what a full AI dynamical-downscaling emulator costs and requires.
